The Subtask Name: Determine the birthplace of Allan Kroeker
Agents:
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed WebSurfer's result and noted conflicting birthplace data (Vancouver vs. Winnipeg).
  -- Observation: Wikipedia said Winnipeg; some snippets said Vancouver.
  -- Thought: Need to verify with multiple reliable sources (IMDb, TMDB, TCM) and confirm filmography match.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to open specific URLs (Wikipedia, IMDb, TMDB) and extract birthplace data.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched for "Allan Kroeker birthplace" and opened Wikipedia page.
  -- Observation: Wikipedia explicitly states "born April 10, 1951, in Winnipeg, Manitoba".
  -- Thought: Wikipedia is a reliable source; need to corroborate with IMDb/TMDB.
  -- Result: Confirmed Winnipeg, Manitoba as birthplace from Wikipedia.
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Directed WebSurfer to check IMDb and TMDB pages for corroboration.
  -- Observation: IMDb page exists but birthplace line not clearly visible in viewport.
  -- Thought: Need to ensure at least two independent sources agree.
  -- Result: Re-instructed WebSurfer to extract birthplace from IMDb and TMDB.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Navigated to IMDb page (https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0471862/) and TMDB page.
  -- Observation: IMDb page loaded but viewport did not show the "Born" field clearly; TMDB page not fully explored in visible text.
  -- Thought: IMDb/TMDB data not fully captured in visible output, but earlier search snippets and Wikipedia strongly support Winnipeg.
  -- Result: Re-searched "Allan Kroeker birthplace" and found consistent results pointing to Winnipeg, Manitoba.
